study: M8 E/I/market_response decomposition and fresh receipt replay 2026-11-20

unscored_fids.reason: FID is absent from the saved M8 score/features; old receipt archive uses a stale 2026-11-12 kickoff while the live Crown response confirms rescheduled kickoff 2026-11-14, so prior horizon/time features and verified FT cannot be aligned.

mismatch_audit_note.interpretation: Mismatches are primarily stale/different Crown price snapshots assigned to a later receipt cutoff; do not treat them as received prices. No substitute market prices were used.

scope_notes: Historical event-time rows are Crown source-event replay; actual receipts are true Crown HTTP received-before-kickoff data and kept separate.
2024 and 2025 are historical pre-forward baselines, not actual receipt years.
Selected subset thresholds are frozen at the 2024-25 historical confidence 80th percentile from the 2026-11-19 study; no threshold was tuned to 2026 realized PnL.
All late receipt FIDs already appeared in the 2026-11-19 design; they are new quote snapshots but not untouched fixture/outcome holdouts.
All selected candidate PnL is quarter-line Crown AH leg settlement at the quote in question; no alternative bookmaker odds were used.
E/I/market_response totals are separate model ledgers with overlap; conflicts are retained and no arbitration rule is applied.
